title: Benchnote
summary: Shared lab notebook for small research teams, with templates for repeat experiments.

data.text: Quillfern Labs made software for university research groups. Benchnote replaced a mix of paper notebooks and spreadsheets with one shared notebook per project.
Odile built the experiment templates and the audit trail: every entry is versioned, and nothing can be deleted, only struck through with a reason, as lab rules require.
This was the project where Odile moved from writing spreadsheet macros to building full products, and learned to sit with users before writing code.
